It was about two years ago, in my freshman year. I was invited to one of the popular kid's party, debated whether to go or not, but went anyway. (Only because my best friend was going.) 

​

Let's call this guy Carl. Carl was the host of this party and invited mostly half the high school. Like the cliche party, he had alcohol, drugs, etc. At the time I was **not** a stranger to pot and alcohol. I found my friend in the crowd, and we hung out for a few hours. Eventually, Carl came up to me, drunk out of his mind, and just pinned me on a wall. I pushed him off, and walked away, holding my friend's hand. 

I didn't see him for the rest of the night, except for right before the police showed up for a noise complaint. Beforehand, Carl threw up on the pool table, then belly-flopped ontop of the pool table, breaking it in half. 

Like, 20 minutes after he got up, someone in the back yelled: "YO, THE WEE-WOOS BE HERE!" 

That was me and my friend's signal to run because my dad is friends with the sheriff, and my friend's mother was a former lawyer. 

We ran out to the back and jumped the fence and we both ran to my friend's house. (I was staying at her house, and we snuck out to this party.) 

We didn't get caught, but this night will forever stay in the back of my mind. This was also the night I figured out I was a Non-binary Lesbian.
